title: Multiplicity and Uniqueness of Stationary Expected Payoffs in Coalitional Bargaining
abstract: arXiv:2611.00542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: I study uniqueness of stationary expected payoffs in random-proposer coalitional bargaining with transferable utility. Proposer independence of coalition surplus does not guarantee uniqueness, even when the surplus is strictly monotone and every equilibrium features immediate agreement. For $M^\natural$-concave characteristic functions, including non-monotone ones, I show that stationary expected payoffs are unique and continuous in the primitives, provided that every equilibrium features immediate agreement. To prove uniqueness, I identify an equitable grouping property of maximizing coalitions and show that $M^\natural$-concavity implies it at every no-delay candidate payoff vector. Using equitable grouping, I show that every no-delay equilibrium payoff vector is isolated and has positive local index. translated_title: 联盟议价中平稳预期收益的多重性与唯一性
translated_abstract: 我研究了具有可转移效用的随机提议者联盟议价中平稳预期收益的唯一性。联盟剩余对提议者的独立性并不能保证唯一性，即使剩余严格单调且每个均衡都呈现立即达成协议的特征。对于M♮-凹特征函数（包括非单调的情形），我证明：只要每个均衡都呈现立即达成协议的特征，平稳预期收益就是唯一的，并且对基本参数是连续的。为证明唯一性，我识别出最大化联盟的一个公平分组性质，并证明M♮-凹性意味着在每个无延迟候选收益向量处该性质均成立。利用公平分组性质，我证明了每个无延迟均衡收益向量都是孤立的，且具有正的局部指标。对于在所有均衡中保持立即达成协议的参数变化，玩家对每个联盟贡献的统一增加……
tldr: 本文研究随机提议者联盟议价中平稳预期收益的唯一性，发现联盟剩余的提议者独立性不足以保证唯一性，但证明了在M♮-凹特征函数下，只要所有均衡都立即达成协议，平稳预期收益就是唯一且连续的。
en_tdlr: This paper studies uniqueness of stationary expected payoffs in random-proposer coalitional bargaining, showing that proposer independence of coalition surplus does not guarantee uniqueness, but M♮-concave characteristic functions ensure uniqueness and continuity of stationary expected payoffs whenever every equilibrium features immediate agreement.
